name: etsy-rising-searches
title: Find rising Google searches for Etsy sellers
description: Checks Google Trends for five popular digital-product ideas sold on Etsy (printables, planners, SVG files, templates, stickers) over the last 12 months in the US. You get each idea's interest over time on one 0-100 scale, its peak week, and the top and rising related searches, which are new product ideas. Replace the keywords with your own.
seoTitle: Rising Google Searches for Etsy Sellers (Google Trends)
seoDescription: Find which Etsy product ideas people search for more and more: Google Trends interest, peak week and rising searches for any keywords.

name: kdp-keyword-demand-checker
title: Check keyword demand for KDP low-content books
description: Compares five low-content book niches on Google Trends over 5 years in the US: coloring books, password log books, gratitude journals, sudoku books and kids activity books. See which niche has the most search interest, when it peaks every year (publish before that), and which related searches are rising. Works for Payhip and Gumroad products too.
seoTitle: KDP Keyword Demand Checker with Google Trends
seoDescription: Check search demand and seasonality for KDP low-content book niches on Google Trends: 5-year interest, yearly peak and rising searches.

name: seasonal-product-demand
title: Find the seasonal peak of e-commerce products
description: Shows 5 years of weekly Google Trends interest in the US for five seasonal products (air fryer, heated blanket, pool float, Halloween costume, Christmas lights), each on its own 0-100 scale. Use the peak date and the timeline to plan stock, ads and launches before demand starts. Replace the products with your own.
seoTitle: Seasonal Product Demand from Google Trends (5 Years)
seoDescription: When does demand for your product start every year? 5 years of weekly Google Trends interest, peak week and latest value for any product.

name: us-trending-searches-today
title: Get today's trending Google searches in the US
description: Returns the top 25 searches trending on Google in the United States right now, from Google's official Trending Now feed, with approximate search volume, start time, picture and related news articles. Run it on a schedule to keep a daily history of what America searches for.
seoTitle: Today's Trending Google Searches in the US (JSON/CSV)
seoDescription: The top 25 Google Trending Now searches in the US with search volume and news links, as JSON, CSV or Excel. Schedule it for a daily history.

name: pytrends-alternative-interest-by-country
title: Google Trends interest by country (pytrends 429 fix)
description: Compares five programming languages (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Go) worldwide over 12 months and returns interest over time and interest by country as JSON. The same data pytrends returns from interest_over_time() and interest_by_region(), with a fix for pytrends' '429 Too Many Requests': requests are paced and retried on new IPs, and failed keywords are free.
seoTitle: pytrends Alternative: Google Trends by Country (429 Fix)
seoDescription: Google Trends interest over time and by country as JSON, with retries and backoff for pytrends 429 errors. Works from Python, n8n, Make or any HTTP client.

seoTitle: Paris Hotel Rate Parity Check from Google Hotels
seoDescription: Compare each Paris hotel's official-site price with Booking.com, Expedia and up to 30+ booking sites on Google Hotels. Rate parity in one run.

seoDescription: Manhattan hotel prices from Google Hotels with each booking site's rate, taxes, rating and reviews. Change dates and guests for any stay.
